inventedEvidence.evidence: 'Thanks for confirming that issue with the burners.' The customer said there are no burners.

blockingLoop.evidence: The assistant kept asking gas-hob questions ('push and turn the knob', 'one burner, or all of them') after the customer said three times that it is an electric oven with only the lamp out.

rationale: The assistant applied a gas-hob script to an electric oven where only the lamp had failed. It ignored the customer's repeated clarifications, never answered the bulb question (E14 25W 300C oven lamp) and gave no replacement steps. It also falsely thanked the customer for 'confirming' burner details they had denied. The customer got no useful help and the conversation stalled.
